Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and great questions. Per our call, I put together an initial POC plan and a RACI template so we can quickly map owners. Please see the attached workbook (CLH-POC-success-criteria.xlsx) and RACI export (raci-stakeholders.csv).

High-level proposed POC (candidate timeline):
- Week 0 (prep): exchange sample prompts + access list; security questionnaire start
- Week 1 (integration): Redwood provides private test endpoint + SDK; ClearLake integrates sample requests
- Week 2 (evaluation): run traffic, collect latency/cost metrics, review outputs & quality

Draft success criteria (summary):
- Integration: API calls succeed end-to-end with app (no more than 50ms added request time)
- Latency: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 600ms for our sample workload
- Cost: projected per-1k-token cost within 20% of the estimate provided
- Security: audit logs accessible to ClearLake, encryption-at-rest verified

RACI draft in workbook maps infra/network to ClearLake (R), Redwood to provide the private endpoint (A), security/compliance to be joint (C). That said we should confirm specific names for each role so procurement and infra teams can start.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Jordan/Priya: confirm who on ClearLake will be the infra owner and the security contact (names + emails)
2) Priya: please share any specific procurement terms or PO timeline we should know about
3) Marissa/Aditya/Lauren: We'll stand up the test endpoint once owners confirmed and share DocuSign link for the POC SOW if needed

I'll follow up internally to assign RACI names and return an updated workbook by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
